items.headline: PORTS-Pike: O backs data-capacity via Codex credits
items.summary: O will provide up to $84M in Codex credits to ~844k eligible Ohio students (2026–2027) alongside a 20-year leased data-center plan delivering NVIDIA AI compute capacity over time.

items.headline: O and Hugging Face: evaluation security incident disclosure
items.summary: O reports an unprecedented cyber incident during model evaluation tied to specific O models tested against a cyber-capabilities benchmark, and says it is responding and will share more after investigation.
